instructions: Bring a medium pot of water to a boil over high heat. Add the sprouts and cook for 2 minutes. Drain them in a colander, rinse under cold water, then shake off the water and pat them dry with a clean towel.
Meanwhile, finely chop the tomato and the onion. Grate the carrot. Chop 3 tbsp of the cilantro.
Mince the green chili and put it in a small bowl for the table.
Transfer the sprouts, tomato, onion, carrot and cilantro to a large bowl.
Just before serving, add the juice of the lemon, 3/4 tsp of the chaat masala and the salt. Toss well.
Spoon into four bowls and top with the pomegranate and the remaining 1/4 tsp chaat masala. Serve right away with the minced chili on the side.
method_notes: Every version uses sprouted moong with onion, tomato, cilantro, lemon and chaat masala, finished right before serving. All of them cook the sprouts briefly (steamed 5 to 6 minutes or blanched), so this isn't a no-cook dish. Archana's Kitchen leads for its 11,359 ratings, but its page shows no star value, so it counts as a fallback. Its mint chutney has almonds, so it's left out; carrot is from Yummy Tummy Aarthi.
